chunks: And Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام said:
"A mourning gathering is held for the deceased for three days from the day he died."

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar, Imam al-Bāqir عليه السلام
key_terms.مَأْتَمٌ: a mourning gathering or assembly of grief
key_terms.مِنْ يَوْمِ مَاتَ: beginning from the day of death

ai.seo_question: For how many days should a mourning gathering be held for the deceased?
ai.summary: This hadith states that a mourning gathering for the deceased is observed for three days beginning from the day of death. It reflects the recognized period for communal condolence and mourning in Shia practice.
